reviews.text: Tint has a lightweight, watery-gel consistency that feels like nothing on the skin or lips. Unlike thick, sticky tints that leave a heavy residue, this one absorbs quickly, so you don’t have to wait around for it to dry before blending.
reviews.zh: Tint 質地輕盈，係水凝膠狀，搽喺皮膚或者唇上感覺好似冇嘢咁。唔似一啲厚身、黐笠嘅 tint 會留低厚重殘留感，呢枝吸收得好快，唔使等佢乾先再 blend。

reviews.text: I really love it! It’s vibrant, flattering, and gives my lips such a fresh, lively look. The texture feels nice and smooth when applying too. The only downside is that it stains the lips quite strongly, so it’s a bit hard to remove completely. But overall, I still enjoy using it a lot because the shade is just too pretty to resist
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意佢！顏色鮮明、襯膚，俾到我嘴唇好清新有朝氣嘅感覺。質地塗起嚟都好滑好舒服。唯一嘅缺點係染唇效果好強，比較難完全卸乾淨。不過整體嚟講我仲係好鍾意用，因為個色實在太靚，忍唔住要繼續用。

reviews.text:
I really wanted to like this one but the formula is so-so in my opinion. There are better tints out there, especially if you are looking for it to last longer than 30min. If a sheer or buildable tint is what you are looking for this may be more your style.

Also, I found it to feel a bit gritty on the lips, but maybe I got one that was defective? I didn’t have this issue with other amuse tints.
reviews.zh:
我其實好想鍾意呢隻，但我覺得個配方普普通通。市面上仲有更好嘅唇釉，尤其係如果你想佢持久過30分鐘嘅話。如果你想搵通透或者可以逐層疊加嘅唇釉，呢隻可能會啱你多啲。

另外，我覺得佢搽上嘴有少沙，但係可能我嗰支有問題？其他 amuse 唇釉我冇遇到呢個問題。

reviews.text: really pretty tint! has a different applicator than the jel fit tint (this one is slightly smaller and a bit more textured?) a bit too warm for my liking but i mean it is supposed to be warm colored soo. anyways not too bright so it blends in quite well with my lips (love putting the fwee gloss over amuse tint for extra gloss)
reviews.zh: 唇釉好靚！同 jel fit tint 嘅掃頭唔同（呢個細少少，質地有少唔同？）對我嚟講偏暖少少，但我諗佢本來就係暖色調囉。總之唔算太鮮色，所以同我唇色融合得幾好（好鍾意喺 amuse 唇釉上面再搽 fwee gloss，加多層光澤感）

reviews.text: I like the color. It needed a little time to sort of develop on the lips imo but after it sits for a minute it looks perfect. It isn't long lasting but I don't mind that at all. I like the color, I'll be buying a backup one. Too cute.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢個色。我覺得佢需要啲時間喺嘴唇上慢慢顯色，但係等咗一分鐘左右就睇起嚟好完美。唔算好持久，但我完全唔介意。我鍾意呢個色，我會買多支後備。可愛到爆。

reviews.text: I like the color. Shining effect is enough for me. But maybe cause of plump effect my lips burn a little bit. So personally for me it doesn’t fit much well. I will use it sometimes but not on a basis way.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢個色。光澤感對我嚟講夠用。但可能因為豐唇效果，搞到我嘴唇有少少灼熱感。所以對我個人嚟講唔算好夾。我會間中用，但唔會當日常用。

reviews.text: I agree with the other negative review, unfortunately. This reformulation is drying and it's more of an oil-based tint now. It has a bit of a greasy feel and it emphasizes texture on the lips and tends to pill up in a very unflattering way. The formula loses its shine quickly and so you have to reapply often. Lastly, it does have a bit of a plumping affect, a very subtle tingle. Choco Girl is a pretty color, a reddish brown that leans chocolately, a very unique shade, but I don't recommend this tint...Amuse's other tints are MUCH better.
reviews.zh: 唔好彩我同意另一則負評。呢個改良版變得乾咗，而家比較似油性唇釉。質地有少油笠笠，而且會凸顯嘴唇紋理，仲會結成一粒粒好難睇嘅狀態。個妝效好快就甩光澤，所以要不斷補塗。最後，佢有少少豐唇效果，就係好微弱嘅刺麻感。Choco Girl 係個靚色，係偏朱古力調嘅紅棕色，好獨特嘅色號，但呢隻唇釉我唔推薦……Amuse 其他唇釉出色好多。

reviews.text: I'm so sad that this product didn't work for me. It is kind of drying on the lips and emphazes texture. Not much shine --- more of a water tint -- but has a slippery oily feel that isn't the most pleasant. Kind of like a dry oil. The Jel Fit Tint has a very similar colour called Seoul Girl and the formula is way better in my opinion.
reviews.zh: 好可惜呢隻產品啱我唔到。搽上嘴有少乾，而且會凸顯紋理。唔算好有光澤——比較似水狀唇釉——但係有種滑潺潺又油笠笠嘅感覺，唔算好舒服。有少似乾咗嘅油。Jel Fit Tint 有隻好相似嘅色叫 Seoul Girl，我覺得嗰隻配方好太多。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
